title: Replit Launches BYOC to Run Platform on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
summary:
Regulated organizations can now host their software development environment within their own security perimeters to prevent sensitive data from leaving their infrastructure. Replit launched its Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) feature to enable this functionality across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud for both development and production workloads. The service is offered in three tiers: a private preview for Full BYOC, which migrates the entire platform to the customer's cloud, and early access for BYOC for Published Apps and Image Exports via Docker and Terraform.

The update targets the healthcare, finance and government sectors to remove data residency barriers that previously limited adoption. This deployment allows security teams to maintain greater isolation by ensuring the agent harness operates within the customer's own cell environment. The company stated the goal is to ensure data belongs to the user and remains within their controlled cloud tenants.
